items: 🏡【Adjustable height ＆Rolling】The tray is made of FSC-Certified materials. The top of the side table measures 15.8 inches long and 11.8 inches wide. This side table with wheels can be adjusted height to suit bathtub, couch, bed, and chairs, while the swivel table can be rotated 360°. The C shaped end table is designed so that it slides nicely under the sofa. This side table comes with wheels on the bottom, you can easily move it to where you want to go.

🏡【Multi-functional small table】This TV tray table is made of thicker steel frame and thickened wood boards to ensure its stability, it can hold laptop, books, you can use swivel side table to work, you can also use it as a couch tray for snacks, drinks and other items. Both top and bottom can hold items to save more space.

🏡【Exquisite Decoration】This C side table has heavy and durable raw material and beautiful appearance. You can match it with other fine furniture and use it as a bed side table, recliner side table,couch table tray in your livingroom and bedroom, and so on. You can also give it to your family or friends as a surprise.

🏡【Prevents falling & Easy to clean】 The edges of this snack table protrude upward, which is great for preventing coffee, foods from slipping out. Meanwhile, the selected tabletop material, wood c table is heat resistant, waterproof and easier to clean.

🏡【Easy to Assemble】 This rolling side table is solidly constructed and easy to understand, you can install it with ease. If you encounter any problem, please contact us, we will reply you at the first time.
